verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM has a first-party docs section titled "MCP Compatibility in AnythingLLM", which points to MCP support inside its agent system. The pack gives only that page title, so how users register MCP servers and have agents call their tools is unshown. The probe calls the same page an "official MCP server", which leaves it unclear whether it covers the client side. Missing for 10: documented steps for adding or configuring MCP servers, confirmation that agents can call MCP tools, supported transports and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
